shortDescription: Vietnam's largest oil refinery, Nghi Son Refinery and Petrochemical LLC, known as NSRP, has secured enough crude oil from Kuwait and other sources for its operations until the end of January, a company executive said.

children: Vietnam's largest oil refinery, Nghi Son Refinery and Petrochemical LLC, known as NSRP, has secured enough crude oil from Kuwait and other sources for its operations until the end of January, a company executive said.

The 200,000-barrel-per-day refinery in Thanh Hoa province suffered supply disruption in March and April due to the Iran war, but has since diversified its supplies and is operating above its designed capacity
Some Russian crude oil is compatible with the refinery but has not been imported due to the "issues of sanctions", said NSRP General Director Kazutaka Yamato
The Vietnamese government as of mid-November was still discussing a plan to build a strategic crude oil storage facility at the refinery's compound, but no final decision has been made, he said
and Kuwait Petroleum both hold 35.1% stakes in NSRP, with 25.1% held by Petrovietnam and 4.7% belonging to Mitsui Chemicals Inc
